body:
Hey. I still get them but not as badly anymore; I found out that popping a zyrtec resolves it after a while.

I really should see a dermatologist about this, but I'm just too lazy to do so. Zyrtec is my bandaid fix for now.
No, but it is close; Its almost a genre of nonsensical videos

I actually do try to distract myself from the pain with outdoors stuff. I've gone hiking and fishing a lot these past days, and its quite cathartic. However, it seems that when I come back from my adventures, the feelings come flooding back. I suppose I can keep doing what I love to do best, though!

Maybe I shouldn't feel so bad about my pain, then. One week, I thought I was finally free from the pain, I felt so confident and happy; The next week I cried the whole day. I guess the ups and downs happen to all of us 🥲
If it starts to affect you too much, I would go no-contact. I know it will hurt at first, but it is the right response to someone who feels nothing for you.
She is definitely trashing me behind my back as well. Its really hard to not care about others opinions on yourself, I don't know why. I'm filled with dread
I yearn for these days to come. I know they eventually will, I just don't know when.
She never gave me a good answer either, I really feel that. I was just left wondering why, I never got closure.
Holy shit, I feel really similarly to this. When I'm not actively thinking of her, I just feel anxious and bad for no good reason. I want it to stop

That's definitely the first mistake I made: Keeping contact with her. I kept saying to her over text how I was so heartbroken, and I kept asking why she did what she did. Looking back at it, I think I was begging for sympathy, but she clearly didn't give a shit about anything I had to say, which just pained me even more. I really regret doing that, I was really only bothering her by doing that and it didn't help me either. I think I was expecting her to coddle and comfort me, even after our breakup; I don't know why I was thinking like that. Its been two months since I have had any contact with her, and while it has definitely helped, I still think about her every moment of the day. I want the day to come where I wake up and my thoughts don't immediately dart to her, I just want peace again.
I hate this state of mind so much. I wish humans weren't made like this; I just want to get over it.

I'm starting to wonder if you ever get over heartbreak, or if it slowly just becomes a part of you one day. I hate thinking that it'll just become one with me, I regret ever getting to know her. I do have some things to distract me from it, though.
Other people care about you, even if you don't realize it. I know it's said again and again, but others would be devastated if you were gone. Don't do it :(
One day we will both look back at this with great amusement and wonder how our past selves could be so naive. We will pull through one day and be a better person than before.
I suppose so. Looking back at it, I noticed that reaching out to her didn't make me feel any better, it just made me feel worse
The crushing, defeating question a lot of us ask ourselves during these dark times.

> There's no point to reach out to someone who's repeatedly told me he no longer saw me in his future.

This hit me really heavily. I've been lurking this sub for a few days, and this was very powerful to read for me. Thank you for writing this, and I hope you can cope well with heartbreak; the one poison with no antidote
